title: Admin/reviewer console coverage remains incomplete despite the new core pages

original_titles.title: Route map largely unimplemented: ~40 of ~50 admin routes have no page
GET /admin/participants/{pid}/state and the /preview, /debug routes are missing (patch E.4)
Shell deviates from spec 1.2: no left nav, environment chip, Cmd-K search, presence, nav badges or degraded status strip
All 20 spec components C-80..C-99 are missing
Destructive-action pattern incomplete: no EffectPreview, dry run, undo indicator or typed-count bulk confirmation
Exports: fixed kinds, inline delivery (no expiring link) and no audit entry
Sensitive-view rule (red 'Sensitive, access logged' border) not implemented anywhere
Disputes not visible to reviewers (spec: /disputes = reviewer or organizer)
Exports synchronous, unsigned, non-expiring (RS-05a S2-part, EX-01a)
CSV participant import (dry run then commit) missing
Ground-truth read side missing; no audit-on-view
Kill switches not togglable at runtime; force-open/force-close missing
/admin/integrity missing; exports are inline CSV, not expiring links
/readyz and /metrics missing; /healthz is /health with DB probe only
Admin surface thin: 19 of 35 A-pages missing; no stage-creation UI at all
Admin console feature gaps (participants, challenges, GT tooling, analytics, exports)
Guards check role only; no state fetch, node-pointer comparison or redirect-with-toast

problem: The admin app now contains Dashboard, Challenges, Setup, Participants, Ground-truth Flags and Ground-truth Bugs pages, fixing the prior absence of basic participant and GT surfaces. However, the wider route map still lacks several operational capabilities: full candidate-bug queue, answer packs, impact preview/rescore/finalization, integrity, preview/debug, participant-state drilldown, bulk CSV import and richer exports.
impact: Organizers still need raw SQL/API or manual work for high-impact workflows, increasing event-day error risk and making the product specification only partially delivered.

verification.basis: Current source inspection at the main-branch commit listed in metadata. Original audit line numbers are treated as historical and were not reused as current line references.

implementation_steps.action: Create a route-to-requirement matrix from the approved current four-level event spec, not the superseded single-round concept. Tag each route P0/P1/P2 and identify API, UI, permissions and tests.
Prioritize operator-critical gaps: finalization preflight, candidate bugs, correction preview/rescore, integrity case handling, full GT authoring/read, event participant state and dispute detail.
Build each page on typed API contracts with pagination, loading/error/empty states, keyboard access, audit/reason capture and role tests.
For any intentionally omitted page, write an ADR/requirements reconciliation entry with owner, risk, manual fallback and deadline instead of leaving it implicit.
Extend the E2E journey to cover the newly introduced admin features with actual UI or API scenarios.

acceptance_criteria: Every admin route in the approved scope has an implemented page or explicit waiver.
No high-risk operation requires direct SQL.
Every operator feature has role, audit, error and E2E coverage.
regression_tests: Add a focused failing test before implementation where practical.
Add a negative authorization / boundary test, not only a happy-path test.
Run the affected backend/frontend suite and the full CI workflow before merge.

residual_risk_or_scope_note: This is partially fixed: several pages now exist, so the original “~40 of 50 pages absent” count should not be repeated as a current count.
